thread_title: Need help with team Building for D-Tide

content:
I'm happy that the team and suggestions helped you last time and you trust me for more advice!<:Agrippa_hug:1356083899553288382> 

This time I put more effort into the explanation part over creating the team codes, in an attempt to help you teambuild for next rotation, challenge higher difficulties and familiarize with bosses! (heads up that many of the wave recs have 4+ characters to account for multiple or flexible teams)

**wave 4: counter**
The second elite fight and boss are PERFECT for counter teams, highly rec having a strength down or weakness as they pack a punch at full damage. Wanda+Caecus is my fave combo but winkle has great synergy too and allows him to exalt more often, however nautila is a popular combo with him too and has great shielding. For either team I highly recommend rousing caecus asap each battle for lots of healing + counter 

**wave 3: high dps**
The second hardest imo, no additional relics while mouchette punishes you for having shield OR not having enough shield and deals very high damage! Despite the poison relic, without xu and an under invested nymphaea, it's more wise for you to have a pure dps team, for now!

**wave 5: vortice or arachne** 
The toughest stage again! I recommend using either votice or arachne support; vortice requires high and consistent keyflare regen to use her pursuit as much as possible while being mindful of tentacle turns, whereas arachne is a safer and slower approach again but this time requires using her weaver pursuit, so healing is super important. (luckily since pollux applies bleed a healer would be wise to bring regardless)
murphy is a good pick to panic-ult when the boss does a high-turn attack and you don't have enough shield, but try to save it until the second phase as the sacrifice can deal a lot of damage to yourself!

content:
**wave 2: high dps and/or high shields** 
The most straight forward imo but it's basically a "sudden death" boss fight where you need to finish it asap as castor deals MASSIVE damage the longer the fight goes on. So I'd recommend faint to be safe (and caro dps are quite strong while an e3 helot removes his frequent shields), otherwise gmurphy aequor is a nice pick as you can steal his strength and use tentacle shield!! (vortice is also an excellent pick if you didn't use her for wave 5)
(also small disclaimer thais on pcaro is controversial for having 2 conflicting embryo functions and "canceling out" the bonus, but personally I still value her on the team to make up for the 200% fusion bar while providing lots of weakness + vulnerable!)
Tawil I highly suggest putting on either caro or aequor teams as her hp% and barrier helps with the huge hp bar and avoiding damage!

**wave 1: what's left** 
The easiest again, I'd leave it last and use your best characters left over that you didn't use on other teams! The boss regularly summons two enemies that give it death res, so it's best to either nuke the boss asap, use poison or strong aoe damage to remove the summons 

Not sure if you use other socials but I believe there's a player that regularly breaks down dzone team recs on reddit, otherwise there's been a new update where you can filter leaderboard from friends too! I've made a promise to not unlock any limited overexalts so my clears are relatively "mid investment" and casual-friendly on hard and nightmare (you might start seeing a pattern as I have faves I prefer using haha)

Good luck for next dzone and hope this helps!! Here's the team recs and a relevant snippets from my guides
